model: ALTA / Phantom II boiler control (Universal Gateway ProtoAir)
equipment_type: Boiler control (ALTA / Phantom II) via ProtoAir gateway
applies_to: U.S. Boiler ALTA and ALTAC and Velocity Boiler Works Phantom II and Phantom Combi II boilers, connected to the Universal Gateway (ProtoAir FPA-W44) on the control's Modbus 2 port.
summary: The ALTA / Phantom II control talks Modbus RTU on its EMS port; the ProtoAir Universal Gateway serves it on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP. The BMS can enable central heat, write a central heat or sequencer master setpoint, a firing rate and an outdoor temperature, and read demand source, temperatures, setpoint sources, burner state, lockout and hold codes, fan speed, flame signal, run counters and pump status.
notes: Supply, return, DHW, stack, header, outdoor and recirculation temperatures are AI objects with a printed range of -40 to 320 °F.
Lockout and hold codes are decoded with the manual's Table 12-14.
The table prints instances with leading zeros (e.g. 001); they are stored here as plain numbers.

source.title: Universal Gateway Instruction Manual (ProtoAir): BACnet MS/TP, BACnet IP, N2, Modbus

integration.summary: Wire the ProtoAir to the control's Modbus 2 port, add the ALTA profile in the Web Configurator with a unique Node-ID and discover it at 50000 + Node-ID. Enable central heat with BV 1 and write the CH Modbus setpoint (or a firing rate with CH Modbus Rate); read demand source, supply temperature, burner state and the lockout/hold codes.

minimum_points.name: CH Modbus Rate
minimum_points.why: Firing rate command for this boiler

minimum_points.name: Demand Source
minimum_points.why: Current demand the boiler is answering

integration.enable: BV 1 Central Heat Enable/Disable enables central heat 1 demand for a single boiler or the sequencer master; it does not revert to 0 if the BMS stops writing.
integration.heartbeat: With the control's EMS Time Out Enable setting on, the setpoint and rate fall back to local mode if the BMS does not write them every 30 seconds; with it off (default) one valid write after power-up is enough.
integration.remote_sensors: The BMS can send the outdoor temperature to AV 12 Modbus Remote Outdoor Temperature.
setup: Device instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + the controller's Node-ID (1-255), so Node-ID 1 gives 50001.
ProtoAir default IP address is 192.168.1.24, mask 255.255.255.0.
Add each controller as a profile in the ProtoAir Web Configurator and give it a unique Node-ID.
The control's EMS port (Modbus 2) shares the RJ45 used for boiler-to-boiler communication; cut a patch cable to reach the conductors (568A/568B colour check in the manual).
gotchas: If EMS Time Out Enable is on, keep rewriting the setpoint/rate at least every 30 s.
CH Modbus Setpoint drives either the single-boiler CH1 setpoint or the sequencer master setpoint.
